scientific_choices.choice: Inspected local section3.5/Algorithm2. Whole-image DeepSolo fallback is retained. A trained router is an approximate extension, not the paper's training-free semantic/lexical rule.

Reuse audited425 frozen YOLO640/PARSeq/CLIP/Text-Kernel/context/VQA features and complete ViTAEv2-S+TextOCR outputs, original TRAIN80/45 and TEST300, exact casefold word multisets and native256 ignore with983/2204 care words.

The latest user authorizes training only the tabular router to approach the fixed-budget oracle. Base recognizers, detectors and embeddings stay frozen. Inputs contain only pre-fallback inference features; no test annotation or actual DeepSolo output enters a prediction.

Fit80 only. Five-fold inner CV on these80 selects hyperparameters per family/budget by out-of-fold combined microF1. Every fold derives its teacher oracle and regression reference only from its own training samples. VAL45 selects among eight supervised families and supplies independent scalar cuts; do not refit on125.

Direct oracle classifiers learn canonical optimal light/defer membership at each budget; a Fraction-based cardinality optimizer supplies zero-residual certificates. Ridge/forest regressors learn deltaTP and deltaPred and rank by2*predicted_deltaTP minus TRAIN-fit all-DeepSoloF1*predicted_deltaPred.

Per-fit TRAIN-only standardization, explicit missing indicators/zero fill, core versus full contextual features, regularized linear/logistic models and small deterministic ExtraTrees. Persist portable JSON coefficients/trees and verify inference against sklearn. No package installation, pickle or neural-model updates.

Freeze all trained models, VAL choices and cuts before new TEST predictions. Compare exact20/30/50% rank budgets, transferred inclusive cuts, all controls and all families. Report oracle F1 gap, canonical decision agreement and symmetric differences; tie-equivalent optimal subsets need not share IDs.

Bootstrap paired images with gates fixed and no multiplicity correction. Fit80 scores are in-sample; inner OOF, VAL45, fullTRAIN125 and TEST300 are separate. Oracle/classification agreement is diagnostic, not an inference feature.

Only80 fitting images, repeatedly explored TRAIN/TEST, DeepSolo Total-Text TRAIN fine-tuning, correlated features, oracle-label nonuniqueness, official metric equivalence and complete latency limit claims. Perfect selection is the target, not a promised attained result.
